text: Hi! I'd love to help redesign your nonprofit's landing page. I work with small, flexible budgets and can focus on a clear message and an easy way for visitors to donate or get involved. Could you share your current page and your main goals for it?

Hi! I build simple, mobile-friendly websites that non-technical owners can edit themselves, including things like opening hours, menus and photos. I'd be happy to refresh your bakery's site so it works well on phones and is easy to keep up to date. Want to chat about what you need?
